title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along campus-edge and downtown Lancaster corridors, each paired with one directly sourced reason to go.

cards.entity_name: North Museum of Nature and Science
cards.title: See Natural History Collections
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor • 400 College Avenue
cards.notes: Walk down College Avenue for natural-history exhibits or a planetarium program; confirm the day’s schedule before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge science museum with exhibits and planetarium programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum at 400 College Avenue offers natural-history exhibits and planetarium programs.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Thursday 10 a.m.–3 p.m. and Friday–Sunday 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; check for schedule changes before visiting.

cards.title: Use the Public Park Grounds
cards.subtitle: Buchanan Avenue corridor • 901 Buchanan Avenue
cards.notes: Follow Buchanan Avenue to the city park for outdoor time; dog owners can use Beau’s Dream Dog Park from dawn to dusk.
cards.short_summary: A city park beside campus with a documented public dog park.
cards.evidence_claim: Lancaster lists Buchanan Park at 901 Buchanan Avenue and identifies Beau’s Dream Dog Park inside it as free and open dawn to dusk.
cards.access_notes: Beau’s Dream Dog Park is open year-round from dawn to dusk; consult posted park rules before entering.

cards.title: Enter Through President Avenue
cards.subtitle: North President Avenue corridor • 230 North President Avenue
cards.notes: Approach from North President Avenue, check in at the modern museum building, and avoid the closed Wheatland vehicle entrance.
cards.short_summary: The correct arrival point for LancasterHistory and Wheatland visits.
cards.evidence_claim: LancasterHistory directs visitors to its museum and Wheatland property through 230 North President Avenue and notes that the Marietta Avenue driveway is closed to vehicles.
cards.access_notes: Use the North President Avenue entrance; on-site accessible parking is available near the Museum & Research Center.

cards.entity_name: Lancaster Public Library – Lancaster City Branch
cards.title: Browse the City Library
cards.subtitle: North Queen Street corridor • 151 North Queen Street
cards.notes: Continue along North Queen Street to browse, study, use library resources, or check the public calendar for a scheduled program.
cards.short_summary: A downtown library branch with collections, programs, and evening weekday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lancaster City Branch is at Ewell Plaza, 151 North Queen Street, and provides educational resources, programming, and community space.
cards.source_title: Lancaster City Branch - Lancaster Public Library
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Tuesday until 7 p.m., Wednesday–Thursday until 8 p.m., and Friday–Saturday until 5 p.m.; select First Fridays run until 8 p.m.

cards.title: Pause in a Public Plaza
cards.subtitle: North Queen Street corridor • 145 North Queen Street
cards.notes: Step into Ewell Plaza from North Queen Street for an outdoor pause, then pair it with the adjacent public library if it is open.
cards.short_summary: A named city plaza adjoining Lancaster Public Library’s downtown branch.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Lancaster lists Ewell Plaza as a public park or space at 145 North Queen Street.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public space; consult city notices and posted rules for temporary restrictions or permitted events.

cards.title: Catch Independent Baseball
cards.subtitle: North Prince Street corridor • 650 North Prince Street
cards.notes: Head north on Prince Street for a Lancaster Stormers game; check the official schedule and secure a ticket before setting out.
cards.short_summary: The Lancaster Stormers’ ballpark anchors the northern Prince Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn Medicine Park at 650 North Prince Street is the home venue associated with the Lancaster Stormers.
cards.access_notes: Event access depends on the current game or event schedule and generally requires a ticket; game-day parking includes public lots.

cards.title: Check the Performing-Arts Calendar
cards.subtitle: North Prince Street corridor • 42 North Prince Street
cards.notes: Walk the Prince Street arts corridor and check the Ware Center calendar for a performance, exhibition, or public program.
cards.short_summary: A Millersville University arts venue near Central Market and Gallery Row.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ware Center is located at 42 North Prince Street near Central Market, Fulton Theatre, and Gallery Row and hosts arts programming.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Ware Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Building access follows box-office and event schedules; children under four are admitted only to designated Family Fun Fest events and require tickets.

cards.title: See a Stage Production
cards.subtitle: North Prince Street corridor • 12 North Prince Street
cards.notes: Continue down Prince Street to the Fulton, review the current production calendar, and compare standard or pay-what-you-want dates.
cards.short_summary: A professional theater destination on Lancaster’s downtown arts corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Fulton Theatre operates at 12 North Prince Street and offers designated pay-what-you-want performances for its production series.
cards.access_notes: Attendance follows the production and box-office schedule; tickets or pay-what-you-want admission are required for performances.

cards.title: Browse the Historic Market Hall
cards.subtitle: North Market Street corridor • 23 North Market Street
cards.notes: Turn onto North Market Street on a market day to browse the standholder aisles; arrive before the 3 p.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A historic indoor public market operating three mornings each week.
cards.evidence_claim: Lancaster Central Market operates at 23 North Market Street on Tuesdays, Fridays, and Saturdays from 6 a.m. to 3 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday, Friday, and Saturday from 6 a.m.–3 p.m.; browsing does not require admission, while vendor purchases cost extra.

cards.title: See Charles Demuth’s Studio
cards.subtitle: East King Street corridor • 120 East King Street
cards.notes: Follow East King Street to Demuth’s restored home and studio, then check the museum’s current exhibition listing before entry.
cards.short_summary: A restored artist’s home presenting Charles Demuth and regional art.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum at 120 East King Street occupies Charles Demuth’s restored home and studio and exhibits his work alongside regional art.
cards.source_title: Demuth Museum of Art | Discover Lancaster
cards.access_notes: Check the museum’s linked official site for current exhibitions, opening hours, admission terms, and any temporary closures.
